title: Hom complex from a K-flat into a K-injective complex is K-injective
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Let $\mathcal L^\bullet$ be a K-flat complex of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] and $\mathcal I^\bullet$ a K-injective complex of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Then the Hom complex $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(\mathcal L^\bullet,\mathcal I^\bullet)$ [def-pur-hom-complex] is K-injective.
